name: Bharat Electronics Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1954, Bharat Electronics Ltd manufactures and supplies electronic equipment and systems to the defence sector. Company also has a limited presence in the civilian market[1]
keyPoints: Business Segments [1] [2] a) Defence (88% in FY26 vs 90% in FY25): [1] The company is a leading defence electronics and aerospace player, providing a range of advanced products, systems, and solutions to the Indian Armed Forces, with core capabilities across Electronic Warfare & Avionics, Communication, Radar & Fire Control, Weapon Systems, C4I, Anti-Submarine Warfare, Tank & Gun Upgrades, Electro-optic Systems, and Arms & Ammunition. It operates through 30 Strategic Business Units (SBUs).
pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 23.6% CAGR over last 5 years
Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 27.7%
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 34.5%
cons: Stock is trading at 11.1 times its book value
Company has high debtors of 170 days.
Working capital days have increased from 79.4 days to 135 days
